sheetsIndicative.note: one data worksheet ('Sheet1'): header Callsign,Product__c,Status,Type__c,Licence_Version.LastModifiedDate,Licence_Version.Original_start_date__c then 146,417 data rows - the Salesforce-flavoured open-data register shape. Status Allocated (96,155), Reserved (49,723), Available (529), blank (10). Product__c carries the licence product verbatim (Full 55,907 / Foundation 34,719 / Intermediate 13,645 / Club 2,119 / Temporary Reciprocal 37 / Special Event Station 3) with 39,987 blank. Type__c is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row (verified constant). Both licence-version dates are ISO (typed at source), populated on 96,155 rows and blank on 50,262; last-modified spans to 2026-01-14, original-start 1903-05-03 (migration floor) to 2026-01-14. Unlike the 2025-11-11 CSV export this workbook carries no Excel-mangled callsigns and no trailing-column artefacts. Anomalies preserved verbatim: 37 M/-prefixed visitor/reciprocal callsigns; 2 callsigns carrying a '#' RSL/secondary marker; 1 lower-case callsign; 3 callsigns with a trailing non-breaking space (G7IWE, G0TQK, 2E1HON), trimmed and counted; 194 distinct duplicate callsigns in the source (195 in the sorted normalised projection after the NBSP trim). ~13,478 fewer records than the 11 November 2025 snapshot (a net removal, not a shift into reserved/available) - flagged for longitudinal analysis, not reconciled here.

normalised--sheet-1-sheet1.csv.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,last_modified_date,original_start_date; 146,417 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning). Status and licence_class (from Product__c) carried verbatim, blank where the source asserts none (39,987 blank licence_class, 10 blank status). Type__c is required-present but not carried (constant service discriminator). Both licence-version dates carried ISO (typed at source), blank on 50,262 non-allocated rows. The M/-visitor and '#'-marked callsigns, the lower-case callsign and the three trailing-NBSP callsigns (trimmed) are all preserved.
